item.tib: srid rgyal thugs bsgrub gzhung gi las mtha' dam sri 'gab 'dre dgra bgegs mnan thabs
item.coloph: de ltar mnan sregs 'phang gsum 'di/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bris pa dge skal ldan skyes bu'i don 'grub shog skal med rnams la gsang rgya tham/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
